stances.quote: I am a champion for a strong national defense and returning fiscal discipline to the Pentagon. I will continue to support a strong military well-equipped to face the challenges of the 21st century.
stances.reasoning: The text repeatedly champions strong national defense and votes for defense authorizations and appropriations, indicating support for more military spending.

stances.quote: I support maintaining low individual tax rates and permitting Americans to keep more of their hard-earned money and voted for legislation to increase the size of the standard deduction and child tax credit.
stances.reasoning: The member explicitly supports low tax rates, larger deductions/credits, and a competitive corporate tax code to let Americans and businesses keep more earnings.
